account.signin.title: Sign in to your buyer account
account.signin.lead: Enter the email address the sales desk invited. We will email you a 6-digit code. There is no password.
account.signin.invite: Accounts are by invitation. To open one, ask the sales desk.
account.code.title: Check your email
account.code.lead: If this address has an account, we have sent it a 6-digit code. The code works for one hour.
account.code.label: 6-digit code
account.mfa.setup.title: Set up your authenticator app
account.mfa.setup.lead: Admins and finance users confirm every sign-in with an authenticator app, such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator. Scan this code with the app, then enter the 6 digits it shows.
account.mfa.setup.optional: Anyone can add this protection. Once it is on, every sign-in asks for a code from the app.
account.mfa.qr: QR code for your authenticator app
account.mfa.secret: Or enter this key in the app by hand
account.mfa.check.title: Confirm with your authenticator app
account.mfa.check.lead: Enter the 6-digit code your authenticator app shows for Vasant Petrochem.
account.confirm.title: Confirm it is you
account.confirm.lead: Accepting a quotation and managing your team need a sign-in from the last 15 minutes.
account.nav.label: Account
account.org.pending: We are verifying your company. You can review quotations now; accepting one needs the verification first.
account.org.suspended: This account is suspended. Please contact the sales desk.
account.none: This email address is no longer on a buyer account. If you think that is a mistake, contact the sales desk.
account.off: The buyer portal is not available here. Use www.vasantpetrochem.com, or contact the sales desk.
account.quotations.none: No quotations yet. When the sales desk sends one, it appears here.
account.quotation.approver: Your company's admin or approver can accept or decline this quotation.
account.team.lead: Everyone here signs in with their own email address.
account.role.buyer: Buyer: follows enquiries, quotations and orders
account.role.finance: Finance: also sees invoices and company documents
account.company.lead: Your GST certificate, IEC and registration documents. The sales desk checks them before your first order. PDF, JPEG or PNG, 10 MB at most.
account.security.mfa.on: Your sign-ins are confirmed with an authenticator app.
account.security.mfa.off: Sign-ins use an email code only.
account.security.export: Download a copy of my data
account.security.request: Ask us to correct or erase your data
account.security.request.lead: We reply within 30 days. Invoices, contracts and tax records are kept for the period the law requires.
